Rosa Park: Kicking off onboarding thread for Meridian Pilot. Quick goals: confirm stakeholders, lock 30d milestones, surface renewal risk (AE noted 'paperwork pending'). Who owns enablement, infra, and CRM watch?

Tom Hale: I can take infra preflight. Tech leads: Aria M. (infra) and Cole T. (integration). I'll schedule Thu 11am PT. Please share any required runbook items before then.

Ivy Singh: I'll own enablement. Proposed sessions: Day 2 basics + auth, Day 6 integration lab, Day 12 testing & obs. Need a 400-row demo set and a 10-prompt bank to craft exercises.

Liam O'Neill: I'll monitor renewal flags in CRM and escalate if adoption metrics lag. Suggest a short weekly health check (Mon 8:30am PT).

ops-bot: Reminder: use template "cs - kickoff v2" for invites and tag owners in the shared success doc.

Rosa Park: Action list: Rosa -> create success doc + timeline; Tom -> infra preflight invite + runbook draft; Ivy -> enablement plan + materials; Liam -> renewal tracker + weekly checks. Reconvene Fri for 15m sync. :thumbsup:
